Strings.homebrewOperationProgressUnknown: winget has not reported a percentage yet.
win.packageManager.missingBody: winget comes with App Installer from the Microsoft Store. Install or update App Installer, then come back and refresh.
win.packageManager.agreementBody: winget’s Microsoft Store source has Terms of Transaction, and it sends this PC’s two-letter region to the Store to work. The app tells winget that you agree only after you accept here. Each package also has its own license, which you accept when you confirm an install or update.
win.packageManager.sourcesCaption: Where winget finds packages. Updating refreshes their package lists.
win.packageManager.localHint: winget found this app on the PC but not in any source. It can be uninstalled from here, not updated.
win.packageManager.confirmInstallFormat: winget will download and install %@. By continuing you accept its license agreement.
win.packageManager.confirmUninstallForma: winget will run the uninstaller of %@. This can’t be undone, and settings may remain on the PC.
win.packageManager.confirmUpgradeFormat: winget will download and install the latest version of %@. By continuing you accept its license agreement.
win.packageManager.confirmUpgradeAllMess: winget will download and install the latest version of every package with an update, except pinned ones. By continuing you accept their license agreements.
win.packageManager.confirmSourcesMessage: winget will fetch the latest package information and then reload your packages.
win.packageManager.noSelection: Select an installed package or search for a new one.
win.packageManager.errorArguments: This version of winget does not support the request. Update App Installer.
win.packageManager.errorDownload: The download failed. Check the connection and try again.
win.packageManager.errorNoInstaller: No installer of this package fits this PC.
win.packageManager.errorHash: The download did not match its expected checksum, so it was not installed.
win.packageManager.errorNotFound: winget could not find this package.
win.packageManager.errorMultiple: Several packages match. Pick one in the package manager.
win.packageManager.errorAdmin: This needs administrator rights. Restart the app as administrator and try again.
win.packageManager.errorPolicy: A policy on this PC blocks it.
win.packageManager.errorVersionUnknown: The installed version is unknown, so winget cannot tell whether this is an update.
win.packageManager.errorSomeFailed: Some packages could not be updated.
win.packageManager.errorAgreements: The license or source agreements were not accepted.
win.packageManager.errorPinned: This package is pinned in winget. Remove the pin to update it.
win.packageManager.errorInUse: The app is in use. Close it and try again.
win.packageManager.errorBusy: Another installation is running. Try again when it is finished.
win.packageManager.errorDiskFull: There is not enough disk space.
